name: scan-wms
description: WMS FG Warehouse - aplikasi scan gudang (Supabase) dibungkus Capacitor untuk Android (APK/AAB) & iOS

scripts.setup:android: npm run vendor && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor "#15803D" --splashBackgroundColor "#F4F7F4" && npx cap sync android
scripts.setup:ios: npm run vendor && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor "#15803D" --splashBackgroundColor "#F4F7F4" && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
